title: "Galway Bay case study"
description: "An applied demonstration of multiscale conservation planning in Galway Bay, Ireland."
---

## Full demonstration forthcoming

A detailed case study has been developed to demonstrate the application of `MultiscaleSCP` to an illustrative conservation planning scenario in Galway Bay, Ireland.

The example integrates conservation features, planning units, and costs across multiple H3 resolutions, applies multiscale optimisation, and compares conservation planning outcomes across alternative approaches.

The full demonstration, including R code and detailed results, will be available once the accompanying paper is published.
